exposure: Prenatal care visits fewer than four
cohort: 422 postpartum women from a comprehensive specialized hospital in Hadiya Zone, Central Ethiopia, selected by a systematic sampling method.
finding: The prevalence of puerperal sepsis was 20.6%, and rural residency, home delivery, fewer than four prenatal care visits, caesarean delivery, obstructed labor, and referral were significant predictors.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was identified as a significant factor predicting puerperal sepsis.
